blockers.summary: Lattice tokenizer/parser/AST and deterministic compact-to-Octad compiler are not implemented.
Semantic validation for atom/relation references, context, vocabulary, permissions, evidence and output invariants is not implemented.
Canonical serializer/deserializer and frozen numeric/Unicode byte profile are not implemented.
Permission-aware host validation, resource-scope checks, delegation attenuation and replay/idempotency hooks are not implemented.
Positive/negative protocol conformance vectors and semantic round-trip fixtures are incomplete.
Hostile-input, permission-escalation, evidence-provenance and unresolved-context conformance evidence is incomplete.
No independent second implementation has passed the shared conformance vectors.
Whitepaper publication revision, source figures and reproducible publication build are incomplete.
SLAI adapter/launcher and pinned package/submodule integration are not implemented.
Final clean release audit, migration policy, canonicalization freeze, compatibility evidence and pre-training freeze are incomplete.
